memos.title: You have died.
memos.text: Do not be alarmed; it is quite common. Your file has been forwarded to Intake. Please proceed to the counter and wait to be called.

memos.title: Congratulations, Clerk.
memos.text: Position: Intake Clerk (Temporary); duties: stamp; benefits: none. Your predecessor is currently being processed.

training.title: Stamp the soul.
training.text: Then stamp the next one. Souls are the currency here.

training.title: Hire Dave.
training.text: Karma Credits pay the staff who stamp for you while you are away.

training.title: That is the job.
training.text: Souls pay Karma Credits; Karma hires staff; the Backlog Report pays you when you come back.
